title: Disputes
description: Review and resolve disputes between customers and providers.

help.title: About disputes
help.overview: A dispute is a disagreement about an order that an administrator decides. While it's open, the order's money is frozen: nothing is paid out, accepted or cancelled.

sections.title: Each dispute
items: Either side can open one on an order that isn't completed or cancelled; one per order. The other side is told.
Mark under review shows an administrator is looking at it.
Resolve dispute decides for the provider: the work is accepted and the order completed.
Close dispute (cancel) decides for the client: the order is cancelled.
Each decision needs a note, and both sides are told.
